# besttraveler

> besttraveler (https://besttraveler.ge) is a Georgian travel company that runs group tours from Georgia (Tbilisi, Kutaisi and Yerevan airports, or by minibus from Tbilisi) to 26 countries, and one-day tours around Georgia. Tour organiser: Natali Iashvili. Contact: phone/WhatsApp +995 579 57 56 36, email info@besttraveler.ge. The site is in Georgian (default), English (/en/) and Russian (/ru/).

Booking: a deposit holds a place; the rest is paid 15 days before the tour; money is not returned if the traveller cancels for their own reasons. Payment by bank transfer. Prices of flight tours depend on air fares and can change.

## Main pages

- [All tours — prices, dates and programmes](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/): Every besttraveler tour on one page: flight tours abroad, bus tours to Turkey and Armenia, and one-day tours around Georgia.
- [Destinations — countries we travel to](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/): Countries where besttraveler runs tours: Egypt, Italy, Spain, France, Turkey, Armenia, Greece and more, with prices and dates.
- [Booking and payment terms](https://besttraveler.ge/en/booking-terms/): How to book a besttraveler tour: deposit, paying the rest, refunds, passport rules and the documents children need to travel abroad.
- [Frequently asked questions about our tours](https://besttraveler.ge/en/faq/): Answers to common questions: how to book a tour, what the price includes, where tours start, which documents you need and when to pay.
- [About besttraveler — who we are](https://besttraveler.ge/en/about/): besttraveler organises group tours abroad and one-day tours in Georgia. Learn how we work, what our tours include and how to reach us.
- [Contact us — book a tour](https://besttraveler.ge/en/contact/): Contact besttraveler to book a tour: phone and WhatsApp +995 579 57 56 36, email info@besttraveler.ge, or Facebook. We reply quickly.

## Destinations

- [Tours to Egypt](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/egypt/): Group tours to Egypt from Tbilisi: Cairo and the Giza pyramids, Luxor, Aswan, Nile cruises and the Red Sea.
- [Tours to Italy](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/italy/): Group tours to Italy: Rome, Venice, Tuscany, Sicily, the Amalfi Coast and southern Italy.
- [Tours to Turkey](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/turkey/): Tours to Turkey: Istanbul, Cappadocia, historic Tao-Klarjeti, Trabzon, Kars, Van and Mardin.
- [Tours to Spain](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/spain/): Group tours to Spain: Barcelona, Andalusia, the Madrid region, and trips that add Portugal or Andorra.
- [Tours to France](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/france/): Group tours to France: Paris, Alsace, Provence, the Côte d'Azur and the Alps.
- [Tours to Greece](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/greece/): Group tours to Greece: Athens and the Acropolis, Aegina island, Thessaloniki and Meteora.
- [Tours to Armenia](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/armenia/): One-day and three-day tours to Armenia from Tbilisi by minibus: Dilijan, Lori, Lake Sevan, Yerevan and Tatev.
- [Tours to the Netherlands](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/netherlands/): Group tours to the Netherlands and Belgium: Amsterdam, Giethoorn, windmills, Keukenhof, Bruges and Ghent.
- [Tours to Sri Lanka](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/sri-lanka/): Group tours to Sri Lanka: Sigiriya, Kandy, tea plantations, the train to Ella, a safari and the ocean — with an optional Maldives extension.
- [Day tours in Georgia](https://besttraveler.ge/en/destinations/georgia/): One-day tours from Tbilisi by minibus: Kakheti, Kazbegi, Truso, David Gareja, Javakheti, Lagodekhi and more.

- [Kars, Ani and Van: 3-Day Tour of Eastern Turkey](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/turkey-kars-ani-van/): 450 GEL, 3 days / 2 nights. Kars, Ani, Ishak Pasha Palace, Van Fortress and Akdamar Island: 3 days by minibus.
- [Tao-Klarjeti Tour: Tbeti, Artanuji, Oshki, Parkhali and Bana](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/turkey-tao-klarjeti/): 480 GEL, . Georgian monasteries and fortresses of historic Tao-Klarjeti: Tbeti, Artanuji, Oshki, Parkhali and Bana.
- [Trabzon and Sumela Monastery: 3-Day Tour](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/turkey-trabzon-sumela/): 470 GEL, 3 days. 3 days in and around Trabzon: Boztepe, Kayabasi park, Hagia Sophia and Sumela Monastery.
- [Van and Mardin: 7-Day Tour of Eastern Turkey](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/turkey-van-mardin-nemrut/): 1,450 GEL, 7 days / 6 nights. 7 days in eastern Turkey: Ani, Van, Mardin, Harran, Halfeti and Mount Nemrut.

## Day tours

- [Classic Kakheti: Ujarma, Gombori, Shuamta, Ikalto, Alaverdi](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/kakheti-ujarma-alaverdi/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Ujarma fortress-town, Gombori Pass, Shuamta, Ikalto, Tetri Giorgi and Alaverdi.
- [Colorful Desert and David Gareja: Dodo's Rka, Mravaltskaro](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/gareja-colorful-desert-mravaltskaro/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Dodo's Rka, David Gareja monastery, the colorful mountains and Mravaltskaro reservoir.
- [David Gareja: Sabereebi Desert Monastery Day Tour](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/david-gareja-sabereebi/): 60 GEL, 1 day. The rock-cut Sabereebi monastery complex of Gareja, 9th–10th centuries.
- [Dilijan Day Tour, Armenia: Haghartsin, Goshavank, Lake Parz](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/armenia-dilijan-day-tour/): 150 GEL, 1 day. Dilijan, the Haghartsin and Goshavank monasteries and Lake Parz in one day.
- [Dzama Gorge Day Tour: Samtsevrisi, Bateti Lake, Shuano](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/dzama-gorge-day-tour/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Fortresses and monasteries of the Dzama Gorge, Bateti Lake and Mount Shuano in one day.
- [Historic Lori, Armenia: Akhtala, Haghpat, Sanahin, Odzun](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/armenia-lori-haghpat-sanahin-akhtala/): 90 GEL, 1 day. Akhtala, UNESCO-listed Haghpat and Sanahin, Odzun, Kobayr and Tamar's Bridge.
- [Javakheti Lakes Tour: Paravani, Poka, Saghamo, Gorelovka](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/javakheti-lakes-paravani-poka/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Paravani and Saghamo lakes, the Poka monasteries, Gorelovka and the Madatapa reserve.
- [Kakheti Day Tour: Chailuri, Gurjaani Kvelatsminda, Zegaani, Sanagire](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/kakheti-gurjaani-zegaani/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Chailuri Fortress, Gurjaani Kvelatsminda, Nato Vachnadze museum, Ziari Lake, Zegaani and Sanagire.
- [Kakheti Day Tour: Nekresi, Ilia Lake, Gremi, Telavi](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/kakheti-nekresi-gremi-telavi/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Nekresi monastery complex, Ilia Lake, Gremi and Batonis Tsikhe in Telavi in one day.
- [Kakheti and Sighnaghi Tour: Ninotsminda, Manavi, Bodbe](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/kakheti-sighnaghi-bodbe/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Ninotsminda monastery complex, Manavi Fortress, Bodbe and Sighnaghi in one day.
- [Kazbegi Day Tour: Dariali, Gveleti Waterfalls, Gergeti Trinity](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/kazbegi-gveleti-gergeti-day-tour/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Dariali monastery, the big and small Gveleti waterfalls, Gergeti Trinity Church and the Gudauri panorama.
- [Khada Gorge Day Tour: Tskere and Rostiani Waterfalls](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/khada-gorge-waterfalls-day-tour/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Khada Gorge with the Tskere and Rostiani waterfalls; an easy 4.2 km hike one way.
- [Kojori and Manglisi Day Tour](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/kojori-manglisi-day-tour/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Koroghli Fortress, Udzo monastery, Manglisi Sioni, Buratino Lake and the Didgori memorial.
- [Kvemo Kartli Day Tour: Tserakvi, Gagi Fortress, Tamarisi Lakes](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/kvemo-kartli-tserakvi-gagi-tamarisi/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Tserakvi, Gagi Fortress, the Tamarisi lakes and Shavnabada monastery in one day.
- [Lagodekhi Reserve: Ninoskhevi (Gurgeniani) Waterfall Hike](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/lagodekhi-ninoskhevi-waterfall/): 60 GEL, 1 day. A hike in Lagodekhi Reserve to the Ninoskhevi waterfall, 8.3 km one way.
- [Samtskhe-Javakheti Tour: Zarzma, Chule, Akhaltsikhe, Sapara](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/samtskhe-javakheti-zarzma-akhaltsikhe-sapara/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Zarzma, Chule monastery and waterfall, Rabati in Akhaltsikhe and Sapara, with a guide.
- [Tabatskuri Lake Tour: Tskhratskaro Pass, Timotesubani](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/tabatskuri-lake-day-tour/): 70 GEL, 1 day. Tskhratskaro Pass, Tabatskuri Lake and its Red Church, and Timotesubani monastery.
- [Tianeti Day Tour: Mamkoda, Tskhvarichamia, Ertso, Sioni Lake](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/tianeti-day-tour/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Mamkoda monastery, a bear shelter, Tskhvarichamia, the Kor-Shevardeni tower and Sioni Lake.
- [Truso Gorge Day Tour: Travertines, Bottomless Lake, Zakagori](https://besttraveler.ge/en/tours/truso-gorge-day-tour/): 60 GEL, 1 day. Truso Gorge: colorful travertines, the 'bottomless' lake, Abano convent and Zakagori fortress.
